title: 22 dreams
content: Man it’s crazy how I feel atm of this post it wasn’t until a few hours ago so I’m sorry if this is long I won’t share all 22 dreams but I’ll put the more interesting ones also I just learned about this whole thing and how it’s connected I’m very new to it all and it’s kinda blowing my mind so I’m not sure if what I’ve seen by anyone else but I’ve had mall world dreams since I was 12 (2015-2016) when I made myself lucid dream it was odd I was able to do it by this alarm method I saw on YouTube I was on the highway on a bridge over it I remember it was pretty dark with the bridges dim white lights and the cars passing by I didn’t really know how to anything or what to even do so I started throwing my hand in the air expecting something to shoot out but a couple walked past and laughed at me and that’s when I thought about spraying molten lava out my hands and it worked I then took off flying and started to shoot blasts of fireballs and molten lava at buildings while I was in the sky and then I don’t remember anything else but I’m pretty sure I just woke up after that I never had a lucid dream and my regular dreams went on time passes by (2018-19) and I get a nightmare in mall world it started in the swamp area which has very tall grass it smells humid clothes and every step sounded wet even though the dirt was solid I didn’t even realize I was at a swamp I just knew I was in a very humid forest with dirty water I didn’t even see water or taste it but in the dream I just knew I shouldn’t go near it another of the things that stuck out there was a skeleton dog that jumps out of the tall grass it wasn’t aggressive just seemed more like doing it’s own thing I seen it jump out but then run back into the grass I think it was more scared of me that’s where I was wrong almost right after seeing the dog I walk along the dirt path and make a sharp turn and I get to one of the parking lots this one had other levels that went up but I was all the way at the bottom of it and this where the horror begins the parking lot is full of TVs in like rows with green static and a blue hue coming from the screen I quickly noticed a stairwell on the other side of the parking lot with a camera on one of the concrete beams I hid and that’s when my view got sucked into one of the TVs and it brought my vision along the electricity to face a little girl and she was like very common horror movie little girl pale skin white gown black hair but her right side of her face was brutally beaten it was purple going all the way up to her eye and her cheek was busted open to the point you could see her left row of teeth I remember this moment I got scared and my view went to the camera where I seen myself running across the parking lot panicking my view goes back to my body and I run up to the second parking level only to be once again at the tall grass this time it was growing from the concrete and I hear someone start saying “walking straight…walking straight….walking straight” I look at them quickly and it’s a man carrying those big blocky tvs he was super skinny so his arms looked like he was gonna drop the tv any moment but he didn’t and then I woke up very very scared after that I didn’t visit mall world for awhile but around (2022-23) they came back I was in the cabins but weirdly the ground disappears there at night the cabins only being connected by wooden bridges there’s a lot of fireflies there too this one wasn’t scary or anything I was just sitting there with people I’ve met and people I haven’t met we were all talking having a good time I think we were drinking something but it wasn’t alcohol we gave each other advice of the real world and the mall world and talked about it like we’ve all experienced it for decades but that’s pretty much it (2024-present day) this is where mall world has taken more personality it’s def way bigger I started going back to school at mall world I experienced the lower levels of the school and the higher level the lower levels were for students that were in a higher grade while the higher level students were the new students that came from middle school I remember going to visit my old teachers from past years and I also remember an infinite staircase that was old very very old it was made out of steel or metal but it had rusted orange you could hear them creek even if students weren’t transferring to their next class the sound would just echo at the end of the day I remember the infinite staircase was full of people some of the people didn’t have backpacks but I didn’t think much of it I just exited the school outside was the bus pickup and I remember I had to walk down these stone escalators with bushes next to them for decor I remember I walked along the side walk with a brick wall and the school name on it and the logo I don’t remember what it said or what the logo was I just remember it was all in white on the orange brick wall one of the main things was that I didn’t remember my bus number so I walked home as I walked home these shadow people would walk by me some would be floating but they would all say negative things to me and it would scare me cause they would get in my face technically screaming negative things about me some threatening to kill me but that was pretty much it for that dream but I kept having more dreams about mall world this one affects me to this day because I genuinely didn’t expect things to go from 0-100 so quick basically I’m in this nice home with this nice mature lady she has glasses blonde grayish hair but she was def way more older than me I remember in my dream I was hitting on her and she invited me to her home I don’t remember much of what happened but I ended up waiting in her room for things to get steamy but she went to go change she was taking awhile to the point where I got annoyed and began to make my way to the front door as I went down the stairs it was weird she had a lot of big windows but they were boarded up I remember she had this very nice big dark oak wood door with stained window panels next to them but the door was also boarded up I remember my fear kicked in and began looking outside the same shadow people from the school dream were now surrounding the house on a little hill they all had weapons some had knives or sticks from like brooms others had AKs and ARs I remember saying to myself that I needed to stop being scared and that this time I was going to fight them I think I began to lucid dream because I pulled out a gun that I def didn’t have and it looked just like the gun you start with in Re4 laser and everything so I began to shoot from the windows I don’t even remember if they were making their way up there or not but I began shooting at them and they began running around trying to dodge my bullets I got some but the ones with Aks and ARs took cover they began to charge up the hill up to the front door I reloaded and began shooting one of them got so close very close and all I remember saying to myself in that moment was he’s going to shoot me with his AK at close range so I feel more pain but no I got him he dropped his AK right to my feet and I turned around and the lady was there before I could do anything she stabs me on the side of the stomach i don’t remember much after that but I think I bled out reaching for that AK This other one happened at a wooden restaurant/bar/casino very fancy I was there with a date I remember the vibe was jazzy and warm soft lighting and everything smelt new perfect date but the food was taking long and we only had drinks I remember telling her something like “when the waiter passes by for more drinks I’ll ask about the food” I also remember exactly what we had ordered I had the house lasagna with soup my date had a lobster with a salad and we asked for water but we also wanted to get some wine and I remember as I was looking around for our waiter a man stands up from another table he looked afraid he had sweat on his forehead and he wasn’t screaming at me or at anybody at his table he was just staring off screaming “ILL TURN THIS BITCH OVER” after repeating that a couple times he pulls a large gun from his waist and quickly points it under his chin and shoots himself his blood painting the big windows behind him it quickly began to turn dark outside and I noticed one hovering shadow figure outside looking at the window I remember I brought my date outside she had came in her own car but I still asked if she was okay enough to drive but she insisted that she needed to get home I remember I was looking for my car in the parking lot but never found it I walked home again this time under street lights by a long sidewalk by a wooded area I remember as I walked home I seen something further in the sidewalk coming towards me it was that same hovering shadow I knew it was the same one they all shared the same appearance other than some having legs and others not but this one was the same one I just knew that it had seen what I had seen in the restaurant I kept walking down the sidewalk and it did the same we eventually crossed path and time seemed to freeze I stopped walking even tho I knew I shouldn’t because wtv it did to make the other guy kill himself it could do it to me too I stayed there not looking at it just staring down at the pavement and it says “yeah I made him do it” and it just continues to hover it didn’t look at me or make a sound after just kept moving I’ve been at the library too where I was hanging out with a group of people and the power suddenly goes out only the white emergency lights stay up barely lighting up anything when a full shadow figure begins chasing us we all separate I follow this one guy into random rooms in the library some of the were janitors closets some where study rooms with certain books and encyclopedias I remember we found this hidden room with a small thing of lockers in one corner and a lot of computers in a circle I remember there was also a cubby with books and we felt safe there but I still felt like the full shadow figure could just come through the crack under the door at any moment weird thing is that the shadow figure either liked to toy with you or it couldn’t really control its powers because the lighting would be very dim and white when it’s far away but it switches to very deep yellow lighting when it’s near by I remember we sat in darkness only thing with light was one monitor that was on at one point the other guy got tired and paranoid of being sitting ducks and he decided to leave me behind to find another hiding spot he said he felt like we needed to keep moving further away but I didn’t like that idea for all we know the shadow figure could just be waiting to hit a corner but I wasn’t gonna try to stop him he left and I stayed behind it was weird too cause when we came in it was all carpet and it had like cream drywall walls and there was bookcases out there but when I decided that it was safe to leave and move forward the outside was more of like old pipes and metal flooring in like a concrete tunnel I don’t remember much but i remember the hallway stretched on for miles in a curvy I believe there’s also like a thrift store or antique shop that also sells electronics I was there with a friend and she wanted to walk around this shop that was huge and it seemed like they also sold like dresses so I could see why she wanted to go so I said sure I went to go do my own thing so she could have space and started to look at the jackets and for some reason they were huge like everything was gonna fit me big I also remembered that it was getting late and the store was gonna close in 15 mins this came with a feeling of fear like something bad was gonna happen if we stayed there after 15mins so I began to rush her cause I got paranoid I think it was her first there because she didn’t understand that we would lose our lives if we stayed I remember she bought a random costume even tho she was looking at dresses and we left I remember walking up some concrete stairs to leave the antique shop and looking back and seeing a Ferris wheel behind this shop that was a little tall and round I remember we said our goodbyes and I went down the street into a smoke shop and the guy who worked there claimed he knew me for awhile and I was his best costumer even though it was my first time there he sold me some weird vape that I didn’t even smoke cause I wanted papers he said I could have it for free since he considered me his friend and I felt really horrible not knowing him but I went a long just so he could be happy after that I left and woke up I have way more many dreams some where I’ve worked at an underground facility under the airport that goes around choosing people at random to go collect other people’s soul energy but then they wipe your mind after you do a day of their work another where I’ve walked a trail that leads to the lake with 2 friends I haven’t seen in awhile and we snuck into an area that we weren’t meant to go into we did it by going through the trees and we seen random stone and wooden structures and as soon as we made it to that area the lighting was darker it was like dusk everything was blue and it got super quiet it was like even the trees we were climbing through didn’t want us there I’ve also been at the mansion where the higher up you go the more the people in that house don’t like you and I think some want to kill you if you make it up far enough I’ve also traveled by plane to another place where I had my own hotel room had girls over and then when I got bored I just walked home The thing that gets me the most is that I don’t understand why this is going on if it’s good or bad I haven’t seen other phenomena like this other than in the US but it’s comforting knowing that I’m not alone and that I hope this is just bring us closer to help each other out of bad things in life but idk nothing can ever be too good for you I thank the people who have reached to the end for reading my experiences because I haven’t been able to talk to anyone about this since I just found out that we are all sharing this dreamscape I hope we all stay protected and stay safe physically mentally and spiritually
